---
title: "Sprott N System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+z^2\\
\dot{z} &=& 1+ay-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.24$ and initial condition $(28,-42,-2)$.
